name: The best parts for AI intelligence, assembled and proven
vision_statement: unconfirmed: for Joshua to confirm. Anyone building AI intelligence can assemble a working system from the best open-source parts available, chosen by measurement and kept current every week, without writing the glue themselves.
opportunities: unconfirmed: for Joshua to confirm. Any product that needs an AI grounded in a person or team's own goals can start from the assembled whole instead of researching and gluing parts again; a production consumer is the hardest test of the assembly.
